plan.title: Race For It
plan.logline: Zapp wants the reward. The reward coin grows far beyond reason. The giant coin topples onto Zapp.

beats.visibleChange: A FREE COINS button flashes on a desk
beats.viewerInference: That button looks too good to be true.

beats.visibleChange: Zapp looks at the button, curious
Kira snaps toward the button
beats.viewerInference: Two people want the same thing.

beats.visibleChange: Zapp sprints to the desk, Kira chases
beats.viewerInference: Whoever gets there first wins... or does he?

beats.visibleChange: Hand hits the button; a coin pops out
Zapp cheers
Coin stands up and doubles, twice
beats.viewerInference: This is getting out of hand.

beats.visibleChange: Coin hops to the floor and fills the room

beats.purpose: Reversal: the prize flattens its winner
beats.visibleChange: Giant coin topples onto the victim
Zapp's face pokes out from under the coin

beats.purpose: Loop: the button resets for the next victim
beats.visibleChange: The button flashes FREE COINS again
